title: Remains of 2 Filipinos killed in Germany bus crash to be repatriated

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine authorities are arranging the repatriation of the remains of two Filipinos killed in a bus crash in Bavaria, Germany, as 27 other Filipino passengers have returned to Milan and three remain hospitalized. The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (Owwa) said on Wednesday that arrangements to bring home the remains were underway in coordination with the victims’ families and according to their wishes. The two fatalities were earlier identified by Philippine authorities as a 58-year-old man and a 27-year-old woman, both residents of Italy.
